mapper.select: SELECT k.id, k.knowledge_key, k.title, k.category, k.content, k.embedding_status, k.version_no, k.status, k.create_time, k.update_time FROM ai_feedback_knowledge_relation r INNER JOIN ai_knowledge k ON k.knowledge_key = r.knowledge_key AND k.status = 1 AND k.embedding_status = 1 AND k.embedding_model = #{embeddingModel} AND k.embedding_dimensions = #{embeddingDimensions} WHERE r.feedback_id = #{feedbackId} ORDER BY r.id ASC
